lesson.grammar_point: modal verb can and can't (ability and permission)

listenings.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome. Before we start, three small things. You can ask a question at any moment. You can write in the chat, and I can read the question for you. If you cannot understand a person, please say it. Nobody here speaks perfect English, and nobody can speak fast in a second language. We can go slowly. And you cannot record this meeting, so please take notes. Thank you, and let us begin.

Hi, this is a short message before the session. You can arrive fifteen minutes early if you want to see the room. The technical team can help you with the computer. You cannot use the big screen before two o'clock, because another group is in the room. If you cannot come, please write to me today. I can send your material to the group. Thank you very much, and see you tomorrow.

extra_audio.text: Joice enters the online meeting on her computer. She listens and she can understand almost everything. She writes her question in the chat. She asks the coordinator to repeat one part. She says her question out loud, and the group answers.

reading.rtitle: Meteoro Program -- How Our Online Meetings Work
paras: Welcome to our online meetings. This short guide explains what you can do and what you cannot do in the call, so that everybody can participate.
You can ask a question at any moment. You can write it in the chat, and the coordinator can read it for you. You can also raise your hand on the screen.
You can speak in your own rhythm. Nobody can interrupt you. If you cannot understand a person, you can say: "Sorry, can you repeat that, please?"
You cannot record the meeting, and you cannot share the document outside the group. If you cannot attend, please write to the coordinator before the call.
